name: Authentication screens validate required credentials
description: Validate the public authentication journey before any protected navigation.

planSteps.description: Open /login, attempt to submit without credentials, then open /register and inspect the required registration fields.
Verify that authentication stays on public pages, required-field feedback is shown, and no protected dashboard content is exposed.

name: Protected routes redirect unauthenticated visitors
description: Verify authorization boundaries for the app's member areas.

planSteps.description: Navigate directly to /dashboard, /proyectos, /personas, and /grupos in a fresh unauthenticated browser session.
Verify every protected route redirects to /login and does not render private projects, people, or group details.

name: Groups directory keeps private workspace content protected
description: Validate the public directory and private group access boundary.

planSteps.description: Sign in with a demo account, open Grupos, select a group where the account is not a member, and request access if the UI offers it.
Verify the directory may show group metadata, but the non-member cannot view members or projects, cannot enter the workspace, and sees a request-access state.

name: Group administrators can create scoped projects with roles
description: Validate the requested group-project workflow and role assignment controls.

planSteps.description: Sign in as the owner or an administrator of a seeded group, enter that group, choose Crear proyecto, complete valid project data, and declare at least two participant roles.
Verify the new project belongs to the active group, is visible in that group's workspace/projects list, and displays its requested roles without appearing in a different group's context.

name: Group switching resets project context
description: Validate the group selector next to the product logo and its isolation semantics.

planSteps.description: Sign in as a user belonging to multiple seeded groups, use the group selector next to the logo to switch groups, then select Inicio.
Verify each switch shows only the selected group's projects and that Inicio clears the active-group context before showing the home content.
